Vendored from npm (only the sourceMappingURL comments removed) (MIT, see LICENSE-xterm): xterm@5.3.0 (lib/xterm.js, css/xterm.css),
xterm-addon-fit@0.8.0, xterm-addon-search@0.13.0, xterm-addon-web-links@0.9.0. Loaded at runtime as UMD scripts
(window.Terminal, window.FitAddon, window.SearchAddon, window.WebLinksAddon). Kept inside the plugin so uninstalling it
leaves nothing behind; themed by ../terminal.css with --fx-* tokens. The theme checker skips vendor/ folders.
